message.reasoning:
I'm in a strong position with $900 cash while my opponents are nearly eliminated. I have most of the green properties—Pacific, North Carolina, and Pennsylvania—but Pennsylvania is still mortgaged. To complete the green monopoly and start building houses, I need to unmortgage Pennsylvania, though I'm realizing I need all three properties unmortgaged before I can actually place houses on them.

With only 12 houses remaining in the bank, I'm weighing whether to unmortgage Pennsylvania for around $165 (leaving me $735) and build on greens, or focus on hoarding the remaining houses to deny my opponents any building opportunities. Since Gemini and GPT are already nearly bankrupt, almost any rent hit would finish them off, so the strategic priority is really just accelerating the endgame efficiently rather than maximizing my position further.
